Places worth knowing

View all →
Countryside

Rothbury

Rothbury is a charming market town in the heart of Coquetdale, surrounded by dramatic hills, wooded valleys and some of Northumberland's finest countryside.
Towns

Alnwick

Alnwick is one of Northumberland's best-known towns, combining a historic market centre with one of England's most spectacular castles and gardens.
Villages

Warkworth

Warkworth is one of Northumberland's most picturesque villages. Set around a bend in the River Coquet and overlooked by Warkworth Castle, it combines medieval history, independent shops and cafés with easy access to the nearby coast.
Coast

Seahouses

Seahouses is one of the best-known destinations on the Northumberland coast. Its harbour, beaches and boat trips make it a popular place to visit, while its location provides easy access to Bamburgh, the Farne Islands and the surrounding coastline.
